Scope: Validation tool supervision only; 27 checks on copied exact scripts in an independent workspace. Real monitor short/stop flows, fast native fixture and synthetic metadata checks are distinct. No long-term stability or cross-hardware claim.
ByteScope: Hashes describe executed local files and copied scripts. CI verifies its own copies; Git checkout line endings may differ.

FastNativeFixture.Scope: Renamed whoami.exe with invalid fixed validation arguments; never classified as PerfCompass telemetry.

SyntheticMetadata.Scope: Never-executed byte fixture and deliberately varied metadata. Covers absent witnesses, mismatched run ID/PID/start/hash, Boolean/string/overflow exit code, mismatched duration, legacy missing witness, supervisor-only startup and incomplete identity.
